rules.description: E/M code billed same day as procedure without modifier -25
rules.fix: Add modifier -25 to the E/M code to indicate a significant separately identifiable service was performed

rules.description: Diagnosis code does not support medical necessity for procedure
rules.fix: Ensure the diagnosis code reflects the specific condition requiring this procedure, not a routine exam code
Verify patient has supplemental coverage or bill patient directly for this service
Bill only the higher-level code. The lower-level code is bundled and cannot be billed separately on the same date
Obtain prior authorization from payer before submitting or appeal with clinical documentation showing medical necessity
